README.md.content:
# Magic UI Solid

UI Library for Design Engineers — a SolidJS port of Magic UI, distributed as a shadcn registry.

## Features - **SolidJS-native** — built with [SolidJS](https://solidjs.com) and [Kobalte](https://kobalte.dev) instead of React - **76+ components** — ported from [magicui.design](https://magicui.design), including animations, text effects, buttons, and backgrounds - **Copy-paste friendly** — install any component in seconds with the shadcn CLI - **Tailwind CSS v4** — components ship with their own animations and keyframes ## Installation First add the `@magicui-solid` registry to your `components.json` (see the [Installation guide](https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/docs/installation) for prerequisites, registry setup and theme injection). Then install any component: ```sh npx shadcn@latest add @magicui-solid/marquee ``` Each component installs its dependencies and injects the theme into your `app.css` automatically. ## Documentation Visit [https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid](https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid) to browse the components and view usage examples for each one. ## Local Development ```sh nub install # install dependencies (nub is the package manager, not pnpm) nub run dev # start dev server at localhost:4321 nub run build # build registry + production site to ./dist/ nub run registry # rebuild registry.json + public/r/*.json and validate the registry nub run smoke # smoke-test all component pages in the browser ``` Before submitting changes, run: ```sh nub run lint:fix && nub run ts-check ``` ## Tech Stack - [Astro](https://astro.build) + [Starlight](https://starlight.astro.build) — docs site - [SolidJS](https://solidjs.com) + [Kobalte](https://kobalte.dev) — components - [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com) — styling - [shadcn registry](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry) — distribution ## Project Structure ```text / ├── src/ │ ├── components/ # Site-only UI helpers │ ├── content/docs/ # Starlight docs (one page per component) │ ├── demos/ # Live demos rendered on component pages │ ├── registry/magicui/ # The actual registry components (source of truth) │ └── styles/ # Global CSS ├── registry.ts # Single source of truth for the registry ├── scripts/ # Registry build, check and smoke test scripts └── public/r/ # Generated registry JSON consumed by the shadcn CLI ``` ## Related - [magicui](https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui) — the original React library - [magicui.design](https://magicui.design) — official Magic UI docs ## License Licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/axuj/magicui-solid/blob/main/LICENSE).

---
title: Installation
description: How to install and configure magicui-solid components.
---

import PackageManagerTabs from '@/components/PackageManagerTabs.astro'

magicui-solid components are distributed via the shadcn registry and can be installed using the shadcn CLI.

## Prerequisites

- A SolidJS project with [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com) configured
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 18+

## Add the Registry

Add the `@magicui-solid` registry to your project's `components.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "default",
  "rsc": false,
  "tsx": true,
  "tailwind": {
    "config": "",
    "css": "src/app.css",
    "baseColor": "neutral",
    "cssVariables": true,
    "prefix": ""
  },
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  },
  "iconLibrary": "lucide",
  "registries": {
    "@magicui-solid": "https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Or use the CLI to add the registry:

<PackageManagerTabs>
  <Fragment slot="npm">
    ```bash
    npx shadcn@latest registry add @magicui-solid=https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/r/{name}.json
    ```
  </Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="pnpm">
    ```bash
    pnpm dlx shadcn@latest registry add @magicui-solid=https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/r/{name}.json
    ```
  </Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="yarn">
    ```bash
    yarn dlx shadcn@latest registry add @magicui-solid=https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/r/{name}.json
    ```
  </Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="bun">
    ```bash
    bunx shadcn@latest registry add @magicui-solid=https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/r/{name}.json
    ```
  </Fragment>
</PackageManagerTabs>

## Install a Component

SolidJS projects can't use `shadcn init` (it's designed for React). Instead, the base theme is distributed as a registry item (`@magicui-solid/theme`) and installed automatically as a dependency when you add any component:

<PackageManagerTabs>
  <Fragment slot="npm">
    ```bash
    npx shadcn@latest add @magicui-solid/terminal
    ```
  </Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="pnpm">
    ```bash
    pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @magicui-solid/terminal
    ```
  </Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="yarn">
    ```bash
    yarn dlx shadcn@latest add @magicui-solid/terminal
    ```
  </Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="bun">
    ```bash
    bunx shadcn@latest add @magicui-solid/terminal
    ```
  </Fragment>
</PackageManagerTabs>

That's it. The CLI installs the component, its dependencies, and automatically injects the entire theme into your `app.css`: all CSS variables (`:root`/`.dark`), Tailwind v4 color mappings (`@theme inline`), radius scale, and animation keyframes (e.g. `animate-marquee`). No manual configuration required.

> **Note:** If your `app.css` already contains shadcn variables, the CLI keeps your existing values and only appends what's missing.

## Manual Installation

Alternatively, you can copy the component source directly from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/axuj/magicui-solid).

You'll also need to install the required dependencies and add the theme manually:

```bash
npm install @solid-primitives/intersection-observer clsx tailwind-merge
```
